tagline: STIHL equipment, servicing and parts in Masterton
heroSubheading: Your local STIHL dealer for outdoor equipment.
aboutHtml:
Jeremy Sharp and Richard Wilton run STIHL SHOP Masterton. We stock everything you need for outdoor power equipment. From chainsaws and trimmers to blowers and lawnmowers, we've got the right gear for the job.

We don't just sell STIHL. We service and repair your equipment, keep parts in stock, and give straightforward advice on what works best for your situation. If something's broken, we fix it.

Come in and see us. We know Masterton and we know our gear. We're open Monday to Friday, 7am to 5:30pm, and Saturday mornings from 9am to 1pm.
servicesIntro: We service, repair and maintain STIHL equipment in our workshop.
